description_en: Deletes transcoding configurations. You can delete specific transcoding templates from a transcoding template group or force delete an entire transcoding template group
description_zh: 删除转码配置信息，可删除转码模板组下的部分转码模板，也可强制删除整个转码模板组
name: DeleteTranscodeTemplateGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the transcoding template group
parameters.name: transcode_template_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the transcoding templates that you want to delete.

Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).
A maximum of 10 template IDs are supported.
This parameter is required if the ForceDelGroup parameter is empty or set to false
parameters.help_zh:
需要删除的转码模板ID列表。

多个ID使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
最大支持10个模板ID。
当参数ForceDelGroup为空或false时该参数必填
parameters.name: transcode_template_ids

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to force delete the entire transcoding template group. Valid values:

true: Force deletes the entire template group and all its transcoding templates.
false (default): Deletes only the specified transcoding templates
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除整个转码模板组。取值：

true：删除整个模板组及其转码模板列表。
false（默认）：仅删除指定的转码模板
parameters.name: force_del_group

NonExistTranscodeTemplateIds.description_en: The IDs of transcoding templates that do not exist when you delete transcoding templates by specifying template IDs
NonExistTranscodeTemplateIds.description_zh: 根据转码模板ID列表删除转码模板时，不存在的转码模板ID列表

items.description_en: The IDs of transcoding templates that do not exist when you delete transcoding templates by specifying template IDs
items.description_zh: 根据转码模板ID列表删除转码模板时，不存在的转码模板ID列表
